summary: Bounce Bot: Cloud Key Quest is a crayon-sky platformer where a cheerful robot trampoline-bounces across drifting, sinking, occasionally popping clouds to grab the golden Key and unlock the far Door, dodging patrolling Hedgehogs with only 3 hearts. Play with Arrows or A/D to move and SPACE / Up to jump (hold for a higher bounce), starting with ENTER or SPACE.
